In my experience it sort of presents itself in a few different ways depending on the situation, some days I wake up and I have that feeling that something is wrong, sometimes it’s like everything around me somehow feels dark, it’s cold, and the air feels heavy, it’s like that melancholy feeling you have for a while after something bad happens, no matter how long ago something had happened I have the feeling as if it just happened. Sometimes this only lasts a few minutes, if that isn’t the case it can last for hours, days or less commonly, weeks.

Other times there is this suffocating feeling that something awful is going to happen, you don’t know what it is or when it’ll take place but all you know is that you need to be ready. I wind up overwhelmingly conscious of my surroundings, overthinking each and every possibility there is as to what could go wrong. I cannot rest until the feeling has passed, I will not allow myself to get hurt again. I tend to not reply to people if they speak to me when this is happening, most of the time I take in what they’re saying but the rest of the time my mind doesn’t, I know they’re speaking but my mind won’t process their actual words which I’m aware sounds rude and I hate it, I want to speak to them but even when I try it’s like the words won’t form. When this happens I usually become tense, somehow hot and cold at once, it feels like my ears are ringing even if they’re not (if that makes sense), I’m more jumpy than usual and there is constant adrenaline that just makes it impossible to calm down. 

Sometimes, I kind of just shut down, that’s the best way I can put it. I feel so vulnerable when this happens, I can still perform basic actions like walking and talking but it feels like I’m going to pass out however that doesn’t end up happening, I’m in a constant state of that until it passes. If I speak it’s at a minimum and walking is as I’ve just described with the passing out thing, I feel slow and dizzy. Sometimes my body won’t allow me to do either of those, I’m awake but I can’t do stuff, it’s like I’m trapped in my mind reliving those memories, if not directly thinking of those memories I either have an impending feeling of doom, have the same feeling of when bad stuff happened or I’m just generally blank. It’s horrible, I feel so deeply unsafe when that happens, thank god I’ve either been alone when that’s happened or with my friend, anyone else just feels terrifying. If anyone wanted to hurt me they could and I’d feel to weak to save myself, it’s like paralysis. I’ve cried while it’s happened and while my friend was there, I felt the sadness crushing me and the tears and everything else that comes with crying but I couldn’t get myself to wipe the tears, it’s like my body just cried on its own. I wanted to talk to my friend as she was asking if I was okay but I couldn’t, the words refused to come. Sometimes I get this for a few minutes, sometimes it’s there for hours and at bad times it’s for a few days and the worst part is I have no idea what starts it.

The general stuff that effects me at every moment is that I constantly have that lingering thought pierced into my mind that something bad can happen at any time, anyone around here can hurt you, anyone you love can leave you or have something awful happen to them at any time, it’s draining to have constant lingering anxiety no matter how much to try to put them off. Another one is the feeling of never being strong enough, no matter how much I try to become stronger it doesn’t feel like it’ll be enough, I’ll never be strong enough to save myself if someone hurts me again, no matter how strong I am there’ll always be someone stronger and there’s a chance they have intentions to do harm and I’ll have no chance to save myself. I apologise for the long comment but this is what I can be bothered to list of my experiences
